title: SoulSpawners ENG
description: Localized, fair and feature-rich mob/spawner plugin
body:
# SoulSpawners ENG

**SoulSpawners ENG** is a fully localized, feature-enhanced take on the original SoulSpawners plugin for Minecraft servers.

With all messages and commands translated to English, and strict anti-farming logic, it's the perfect drop-in solution for fair soul collection, player-driven mob farming, and creative gameplay.

## Features

- Souls drop only from player kills
No more automated farms or drops from environmental damage! Only real player kills of living, spawnable mobs can produce soul items.
- In-game drop rate command
- add Mobs to the blacklist in the config.yml

```
/ss chance
```
shows the true, calculated drop chance loaded by the plugin
- in depth config!
 - Drop rates by percentage
 - Custom soul item material
 - Crafting recipe for empty spawners
- All Messages and notifications translated to English
- Anti-abuse and bugfixes
 - No souls from item entities (no armor stands, minecarts, etc.)
 - Prevents infinite farm abuse
- Open source, MIT Licensed, and based on the original SoulSpawners by mvk, with extensive improvements by VizionFox

# Getting started

1. Drop the JAR file into your plugins folder.
2. Adjust config.yml for preferred drop rates or recipes.
3. Restart your server.
4. Use /ss chance to verify your soul drop settings are correct!

# Support
See the [Github Repository](https://github.com/vizionfox/soulspawners-eng) for updates, bug reporting, and source code.
